A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine (AD330-335). Reverse: Victory on prow with sceptre and shield. Obverse: Helmetted and cuirassed bust left Obverse inscription: CONSTANTIN[OPOLIS] Reverse: Victory on prow with sceptre and shield Reverse inscription: None Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 17.92mm; weight: 2.01g
